text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thanks for letting me take yesterday off!
I was able to get some great rest.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Here, this is for you as a thank-you!
There's herbal medicine inside.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: This works wonders for restoring energy and stamina. You've seemed tired lately, so here, take it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I can guarantee its effectiveness.
I drank it yesterday, and look at me now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having rested thoroughly and gained vigor from the herbal medicine, Satono Crown seems to have fully restored her strength!
